title: [Decision] Eight obsolete planning docs, a stale ARCHITECTURE.md, a 1,576-line CHANGELOG [Unreleased] stuck at 11.10.0 and 44 audit files with no retention rule: delete, archive, or keep with banners
body:
Ruled: 6417413905 · letter A · 2026-10-26T13:39Z

Filing gate ②: a maintainer-only decision. Maintainer, 2026-10-26, verbatim: 「完整的评估本项目， 还有哪些可以优化的地方。包括 ci 和文档」 then 「使用 pm-dispatch 技能创建 issue，需要决策的立为决策卡。」 and 「低优先级的先不考虑」. Batch-of: 19 (repository evaluation 2026-10-26, `session_019a9XCWsbMFp75REzthE6cs`; 9 decision cards + 10 execution cards). Reader: the director seat presents this card in a decision batch; after the ruling the lane named under "After the ruling" dispatches. ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: REST list (439 issues), grep `NEXT_STEP|DX_ROADMAP|upgrading-to-11|v17-docs-sweep|launch-readiness|ARCHITECTURE.md` → 0 hits; grep `CHANGELOG` → 3 hits (#25638, #25806 closed: attribution of 18.1.0 entries; #25321 closed), none about the root CHANGELOG's unreleased section or the planning docs. **New.**

## 维护者速读

当前版本 18.1.0，但 `docs/` 下一批一次性规划文档停在早得多的时代：`NEXT_STEP.md` 写 v4.0 计划且有 2 个死链；`DX_ROADMAP.md` 停在 2026-02 的 v3 时代；`PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP.md` 是 2026 年 Q1–Q4 路线图；`upgrading-to-11.md` 对应 10→11，而公开页 `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:580` 还把读者引到这个仓库路径；`v17-docs-sweep.md` 的 v17 早已关闭但 `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` 在 4 处读它当指纹账本（删前要改脚本）；`launch-readiness.md`「v1/GA 草稿」有 13 处入链；`plans/m1-project-artifact-schema.md`、`plans/release-15.1-test-plan.md` 早过了它们的版本。`ARCHITECTURE.md` 页首「January 2026」、页尾「February 2026」，「未来考虑」里的多租户和插件注册表早已上线，它和 `RELEASE_NOTES.md` 都引用一个不存在的 `.changeset/v5-project-to-environment-rename.md`。根 `CHANGELOG.md` 挂着 1,576 行 `[Unreleased]` 覆盖 12.x–14.x「迁移中」，最后打标签的是 11.10.0；`RELEASE_NOTES.md:14` 写「v4.0.4 in progress」。`docs/audits/` 44 份带日期文件没有保留规则，9 份零引用。删文档是「卡的命运」一类，请裁：**A** 删除（git 历史即归档）过期规划文档与 plans，修脚本路径与入链；ARCHITECTURE.md 折成指针页指向 `content/docs/concepts/architecture.mdx`；根 CHANGELOG 收成「历史 ≤11.10 + 指向 content/docs/releases」，RELEASE_NOTES 冻结去掉 in progress；audits 加「open → closed → `docs/audits/archive/`」规则并归档 2026-06 系列；**B** 同 A 但移入 `docs/archive/` 而非删除；**C** 全部保留，只加「历史文档」横幅与修死链。选 A / B / C？

## Governing text

- AGENTS.md 「Documentation Guardrails」 (line 705 onward) and the release-owned docs rule; `RELEASE_NOTES.md:3-8` and `CHANGELOG.md:9-22` both state the canonical release narrative is `content/docs/releases/` plus the per-package changeset CHANGELOGs.
- `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs:29,126,344,737` read `docs/v17-docs-sweep.md`.
- `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:580` → `docs/upgrading-to-11.md`.
- `ARCHITECTURE.md:3`, `RELEASE_NOTES.md:11` → `.changeset/v5-project-to-environment-rename.md` (absent: `ls .changeset/v5-project-to-environment-rename.md` → no such file).
- North Star 「阶段姿态」: 速度优先于兼容；退役立即生效。
- Triage human floor 「卡的命运(关 not planned、降级、撤回、砍半)」 extends to deleting documents nobody has ruled dead.

## Premises

- P1 — inbound references: `grep -rn 'NEXT_STEP\|DX_ROADMAP\|PLUGIN_ECOSYSTEM_MAP\|upgrading-to-11\|v17-docs-sweep\|launch-readiness' --include='*.md' --include='*.mdx' --include='*.mjs' --include='*.ts' . | grep -v node_modules` (the audit read 1 / 2 / 1 / 1 / 4 / 13 hits respectively).
- P2 — `grep -n '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | head -3` → `[Unreleased]` at line 24, `[11.10.0]` at 1600.
- P3 — `docs/audits/README.md` indexes only the 2026-06 liveness series; 9 files have zero inbound references (list in the audit: `2026-06-ask-build-agent…`, `2026-08-partial-retirement…`, five 2026-09 censuses, `2026-09-tenancy-ledger…`, `gate-census-2026-09.md`).

## One-sentence problem

A reader who opens `docs/` or the root of the repository meets plans for versions four to fourteen majors ago, two release narratives that contradict the canonical one, and a dead link in a published SDK page.

## Options

| Option | What | Consequence | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | Delete the obsolete planning docs and plans; fix the four script paths and the inbound links; ARCHITECTURE.md → pointer; root CHANGELOG → history + pointer; RELEASE_NOTES frozen; audits lifecycle rule + archive the closed 2026-06 series. | Clean root; history stays in git; `check-future-spec-major.mjs` needs its fingerprint source moved (into the script or a `scripts/data/` file). | devx · 2 PRs (docs; script+docs) · precedent: none read |
| B | Same, but `git mv` into `docs/archive/` instead of deleting. | Files stay greppable in the tree; lychee and the drift check must exclude the folder or they red on it. | devx · 2 PRs |
| C | Banners + link fixes only. | Readers still find the plans first; nothing is lost. | devx · 1 PR |

## Business meaning

- A: the repository says what is true today and nothing else.
- B: a museum wing, labelled.
- C: keep everything, warn on the door.

## 四维分析

- **实际业务需求**：读者是新贡献者与席位。`client-sdk.mdx:580` 是公开页上的死链，北极星第 4 条「写给 AI 的文档说错一句等于产品缺陷」直接命中。
- **项目长远合理性**：发布叙事已经宣布唯一真源是 `content/docs/releases/`，根 CHANGELOG 的 1,576 行「迁移中」是未完成的迁移；完成它比维持三份更可持续。
- **防 AI 犯错**：席位会 grep 到 `NEXT_STEP.md` 的 v4 计划并据此判断「还没做」；过期文档对 AI 不是噱头，是错误前提。删除比横幅可靠，因为 grep 不读横幅。
- **创业阶段不扩散**：删大于加；A 不新增目录；audits 的归档规则是一行约定，不是门禁。

## Recommendation

**A.** 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

Confidence gaps: whether any external page links to `docs/launch-readiness.md` or `ARCHITECTURE.md` (the README badge area links the docs site, not these); the dev greps README and the docs site before deleting.

## After the ruling

- A or B: devx execution seat; PR 1 docs-only (root files, `docs/`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx`), PR 2 `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` fingerprint relocation with its `--self-test` extended. Neither touches a governed surface unless `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` is edited (it is not).
- C: one docs PR.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性：完成已宣布的发布叙事迁移，根目录只留今天为真的文档。
② 实际业务拉动：公开页 client-sdk.mdx:580 死链；新读者先遇到 v4 计划。
③ 防 AI 犯错：席位 grep 到过期计划会当成未做的事实；删除比横幅可靠。
④ 创业阶段不扩散：删大于加，零新门禁；audits 归档是一行约定。
Prior rulings read: changelog,release notes,archive,obsolete docs → 2 hits (#25638, #25806 attribution only); none; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Related

#25638 (closed), #25806 (closed), #25919 (open: narrative cost, ruled A — "存量不横扫" governs comments in source, not planning documents).
